tei:div.tei:p: gnam chos thugs gter ming gi mngon brjod las: king kang rigs bco lnga'i sgrub thabs las king kang dmar byed sgrub pa bzhugs so: ྈྈྈ hya hya hya: ྈ na mo ya mānta ka rakta ye: king kang dmar byed sgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: bskyed rim rang nyid dmar byed ni: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis phyag mtshan 'di ltar ro: ral gri tho ba phyag na 'dzin: dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: de ltar bsgoms la sngags 'di bzla/ oṃ king kang hūm̐ hūm̐ bhig nan: de yis king kang dmar byed 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈྈ ྈ thugs kar ya dmar sngags kyis bskor ba bskyed: sngags grangs sgrub pa'i grangs ka med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum pa bya lo rgyal zla ba'i bcu dgu'i nyin gshin rje dmar byed nyid kyis dngos su gsungs so/// /1$0000230'di'i dbang gzungs dbang ltar ro/// /
